correctness.rationale: The lower and upper bounds meet at t=cos(pi/(2N))/(sqrt(2) cos(pi/N)). The lower bound is forced by the unrotated diagonal support and the published coordinate-symmetric lattice-covering criterion. The upper bound follows from the published Steiner-symmetrization criterion after proving, by exact support-line algebra, that every reduced rotation has a vertical chord of length at least twice the diagonal support coordinate. Both N modulo 8 cases are covered, including the unique active-side switch.

originality.rationale: The primary paper explicitly anticipates handling all regular 4m+2-gons similarly, so the direction is close prior art, but it states exact values only for N=6 and N=10 and provides no all-N formula or uniform proof. Targeted semantic-index and web searches did not locate the claimed expression or an equivalent later theorem.
residual_risks: The primary paper explicitly says that all regular 4m+2-gons can be dealt with similarly, so the general direction is anticipated and an equivalent unpublished calculation may exist.
An equivalent closed form could appear in later or differently indexed literature not captured by the targeted searches.
The thesis was used only through its official abstract for scope corroboration, not as evidence of whole-document absence.

value.rationale: The theorem completes the exact even-regular-polygon classification when combined with the published 4m formula. It replaces potentially growing case-by-case trigonometric work by one uniform support-line identity and sign argument, and is therefore a motivated complete family result rather than a routine single-parameter increment.
